historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 544 Noe Street, with stipulations that the appellant meet the Planning Code requirement to provide two off-street parking spaces and that the studio unit have electrical cooking facilities.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Zoning Administrator's determination regarding the property at 544 Noe Street, the motion to overrule having failed for want of four votes.

The Board of Permit Appeals, on rehearing, overruled the Zoning Administrator's determination regarding the property at 544 Noe Street, requiring the garage door to be widened with an overhead garage door installed.
